summary:
Earth Jukebox, developed by Team AstroFlux for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, is an innovative, accessible platform that transforms NASA's Earth visualizations and environmental data into musical sounds.
The main objective of this project is to make Earth science accessible to everyone, including people who are blind or have low vision. It converts visual information into sound using a technique called sonification.
In this system:
Movement is converted into rhythm.
Intensity is represented through volume.
Changes in data are represented through pitch.
Tempo, timbre, and spatial audio provide additional information.
